sections.translation:
<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="General characteristics">
    | Parameter | Specification |
    | --- | --- |
    | Channels | 24 channels; 12 physical faders expandable to 24 via UX-6 modules |
    | Virtual faders | 12 (UX24 base) Operable from the touchscreen or web interface |
    | Remote control | Internal web interface (HTML5) for remote operation via LAN |
    | Input distribution | Configurable across the 24 channels |
    | Scenes | 12 user scenes (input configuration, channel assignment, process settings) |
    | Touchscreen | 7” — 1024 × 600 pixels, multi-touch |
    | Channel displays | OLED (name, input level, fader level, special indicators) |
  </Accordion>
